title: Nikortsminda Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual Nikortsminda Cathedral: compact gray-tan stone church with cross-gabled silver metal roofs, tall12-sided narrow-slit drum/conical roof/cross, shallow round blind arcades with selected geometric crosses/rosettes and nested stone portal surrounds. Approximate western three-storey campanile with lower closed arched fields, open middle/narrower upper belfries, gray hipped roof/cross; lower porch and map-envelope ranges complete the body. Four existing shared ashlar/limestone/standing-seam metal/wood graphs, linear tints, metric UVs, flat architectural normals and four browser levels. Fine figurative carving/inscriptions/interlace, frescoes/full interiors/bells, hidden rear window/roof joins, exact tower separation and surveyed court/thresholds remain approximate or excluded.
